verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Codex can be started from external triggers (GitHub/GitLab/Linear/Slack events) and run in cloud/CLI environments, but there is no documented rules engine, event-trigger configuration, or automation/if-then rule system that lets a user define conditions that automatically fire actions. Everything described is either user-initiated task delegation or interactive session control (MCP, subagents, sandbox permissions) rather than a rule-based automation trigger system. Missing for evidence of delivery: a documented mechanism to define custom trigger rules (e.g., 'on PR opened, run X') and evidence of automatic unattended execution tied to arbitrary events.
